tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the SkillSafe registry for AI coding skills. Returns a compact list of matching skills with metadata.

tools.name: recommend_skills
tools.description: Given a task description, recommend the most relevant skills from the SkillSafe registry. Call this before attempting non-trivial tasks like creating presentations, building bots, or generating reports.

tools.name: get_skill_info
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific skill by namespace and name (e.g. @anthropics/pptx).

tools.name: get_install_commands
tools.description: Get the commands to install a skill from the SkillSafe registry (npx skills add, or git clone), plus its version, file list, and scan verdict. Installs nothing itself: run one of the returned commands to install. Does not return file contents.

tools.name: scan_skill
tools.description: Scan skill files for security issues. Provide file paths and contents to analyze for vulnerabilities, prompt injection, credential exposure, and other risks.

tools.name: scan_mcp_config
tools.description: Scan MCP tool definitions or server configurations for poisoning patterns (injection tags, credential theft, stealth instructions, exfiltration).
